biography.value:
Description

Multiple angry icy snake-like heads rise from the sleek, serpentine blue body of this terrifying monster.

Defense

AC 18, touch 9; flat-footed 17 (+1 dex, +9 natural, -2 size)

hp 94 [133] (7d12+56); Fast Healing 7 [4 heads]

Fort +11, Ref +8, Will +8

Immune Paralysis, Sleep

Resist Ice 10, wind 50%

Weakness Fire

Offense

Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft.

Melee 4 Bites +10 (2d6+7), Tail Slap +5 (1d8+5)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Pounce, 4 Breath Weapons (15-ft. cone, DC 19, 3d4 ice, usable every 1d4 rounds)

Statistics

Str 20, Dex 12, Con 22, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 9

Base Atk +7; CMB +14; CMD 25 (can't be trip)

Feats Combat Reflexes, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Toughness

Skills Perception +13, Swim +12; Racial Modifier +2 Perception

SQ Hydra Traits, Polar Bulwark, Fast Healing

description.value: A cryohydra's fast healing ability is double to its current number of heads. A cryohydra loses all fast healing when it is reduced to a single head.

effect: Fast healing per own special ability, not HP header: 8/6/4/0.

description.value: Any critical hit has a 75% chance to sever a head. You cannot sever the last head but a cryohydra loses its fast healing if they only have one head remaining. A cryohydra can't attack with a severed head, but takes no other penalties. A cryohydra also loses one of its breath weapons per head lost.

effect: On a confirmed critical [[1d100]]: on 01-75 sever an intact head other than the last.

description.value: Once per day, a cryohydra can become immune to physical damage for one round, must have at least two heads to use this ability and those two heads must channel this effect until the end of the round, while channeling, each other head may be used to perform an attack or a breath weapon.

effect: Choose two intact heads to channel to end of round. Immune to physical damage for one round; only other heads may bite or breathe.

description.value: When a cryohydra makes a charge, it can make a full attack.

effect: Charge and full attack with available heads and tail.
